_readme: Gremlin World sample. Rooms are cube panoramas. Positions are {face, x, y} in face pixels (0-1024; faces: front/right/back/left/floor/ceiling). 'at' = position on the drawn SVG room; 'atArt' = position when painted art (assets/world/<room>/<face>.webp|png) is present. Items with no atArt are hidden in painted-art mode unless they carry their own 'img'. Types: portal, sock, egg, arcade (opens the cabinet named by 'machine'; machines live under 'arcade'). See README-world.md. Extra types: scoreboard (chalk Brawl board, draws the shared top 3s), guestbook (opens the guestbook). 'painted': true marks rooms with painted art, so the quest journal counts only the secrets you can find there. 'badges', 'guestbook' and the arcade 'ranked' flags must match the ids seeded in supabase/migrations (see README-world.md).

greet.text: Welcome to the wider office! Five gremlin socks went missing in the wash. If you spot one, give it a tap.

items.label: Supply closet (it's a tunnel)
A stray sock
items.say: My lucky sock! It was under my desk the whole time. Thank you!

items.label: The GREMLINS ONLY door, to the Gremlin Wing

greet.text: It's a burrow, not a scary tunnel. Lamps, cushions, tea. The gallery is round the bend.

items.label: Round the bend to the Gallery of Odd Things
Supply closet: back to the Office
A tiny green door. Beeping behind it.
A very tiny door

card.title: Too small. Try later.
card.text:
You knock. The door is about the size of a slice of toast.

A tiny voice: "Too small, try later!"

items.repeat: Still too small. (You're doing great, though.)

items.label: Door: Do Not Feed the Printer

card.title: Do Not Feed the Printer
card.text:
Knock knock.

From somewhere behind the door, a slow, contented hum. The printer is having a nap.

A note taped below the sign: "Paper jams are just the printer taking a breath."

artCard.title: Do Not Feed the Printer
artCard.text:
Someone hung this by the supply closet.

From somewhere far off, a slow, contented hum: the office printer, having a nap.

A note in smaller writing: "Paper jams are just the printer taking a breath."

items.label: A filing drawer with a label

card.title: Forms drawer
card.text:
The drawer is politely stuck. It is very, very full.

A sticky note on the handle: "Forms overflow. See Archive."

items.label: Chalk doodles

card.title: The doodle wall
card.text:
Gremlin faces, a star, a sock (suspicious), a sun, and a line of little glyphs signed by six sets of initials.

The glyphs are Gremlish. Nobody here will translate them for you. Yet.

items.label: A round window full of stars

card.title: The star porthole
card.text:
A round window in the burrow wall, full of stars. It's painted on.

The gremlins come here to look at it for a minute when a day has been a lot. It works anyway.

items.label: A jar on the top shelf

card.title: Jar of Spare Patience
card.text:
Label: "Spare Patience. Take what you need."

It's about half full. It's always about half full, no matter how much anyone takes.

items.label: A little round hole in the wall

card.title: Occupied!
card.text:
You peek into the little round hole. A sleepy voice from inside: "Occupied! Five more minutes."

Someone in there is taking a very good nap.

items.label: Cushions under a sign

card.title: The cushion pile
card.text:
Three cushions, one lamp, a sign in Gremlish.

The burrow is the gremlins' favourite place to sit down for a minute between big ideas. You're welcome to as well.

items.label: A little kettle

card.title: The burrow kettle
card.text:
It's always almost ready.

Vesper says the waiting is part of the tea.

items.label: Gremlin News Network desk

card.title: Gremlin News Network
card.text:
Nancy, anchoring from a cardboard desk: "Tonight's top story: five socks remain missing. Experts advise: look low, look up, and look under things."

Dot, operating a camera made from a box: "And we're... still live."

items.label: A stray sock
items.say: How did it get up on the roots?! Thank you. I'll keep it somewhere sensible. Like a drawer.

items.label: A stray sock
items.say: My camera-cleaning sock! The news can go on. Thank you!

greet.text: Welcome to the gallery. I curated it. Mostly by accident. Please walk slowly; the art is shy.

items.label: Door back to the Office
Round hole back to the tunnel
A round hatch in the floor
Mona, Mostly (a painting)

card.title: Mona, Mostly
card.text:
After da Vinci, by Moth.

Her missing eye was out to lunch. It just got back, and it would like you to know it saw that.

items.label: Self-Portrait as a Sock (a sculpture)

lines: The sculpture would like you to know it is NOT one of the missing socks. It is art.
It says it's been practising sitting very still. It's getting good at it.
It asks if you've tried wiggling your toes today. No reason.

items.label: Noodle's Hot-Sauce Pie

card.title: Noodle's Hot-Sauce Pie
card.text:
On loan from Noodle's kitchen. Noodle says it's "only a little spicy."

The plinth has been quietly moved a bit further from the visitors each week.

artCard.title: Still Life with Hot-Sauce Pie
artCard.text:
A portrait of Noodle's hot-sauce pie. The real one is in Noodle's kitchen, where Noodle says it is "only a little spicy."

The painting was moved a bit further from the snack table, just in case.

items.label: Small glyphs under a plaque

card.title: Fine print, in Gremlish
card.text:
Two short lines of little glyphs. The gremlins write in Gremlish when something matters to them.

If you crack it, keep it to yourself for a bit. It's more fun that way.

items.label: Portrait of a Houseplant

card.title: Portrait of a Houseplant
card.text:
The office plant, painted from life over six months. It sat very still.

It grew one new leaf during the sitting, which the artist had to add at the last minute. There's a note on the pot. Pip says it's from "nobody."

items.label: Morning Practice (a painting)

card.title: Morning Practice
card.text:
Three chickens, mid-tai-chi. The gremlins swear the chickens hold each pose for exactly one slow breath.

Nobody knows where the chickens practise. Somewhere sunny, presumably.

items.label: Untitled (Reminder)

card.title: Untitled (Reminder), 2026
card.text:
Sticky note on canvas. The note says:

Why did the gremlin sit on the clock?
To be on time.

Critics are divided.

items.label: Mountain of Unfinished Ideas

card.title: Mountain of Unfinished Ideas
card.text:
Every crumpled page is an idea that's still cooking.

It grows a little every day. Grimble calls it "the compost heap of genius."

items.label: A sign: Lost Gremlin Library

card.title: Lost Gremlin Library
card.text:
The sign points firmly at a wall.

The library is, as advertised, lost.

items.label: A tower of mugs

card.title: Tower of Borrowed Mugs
card.text:
Every mug the gremlins have ever "just borrowed for a second."

It is very steady. Please don't test this.

items.label: A stray sock
items.say: Found it on the Mountain of Unfinished Ideas? That tracks. Thank you, friend.

greet.text: Welcome to the Archive. Every strip we finish gets a frame. Feel free to sit; the chair is very good at its job.

items.label: Arched door, up to the Gallery
The library ladder goes all the way up
Framed comic strip
Framed comic strip
Framed comic strip
Two empty frames

card.title: Saved for later
card.text:
Two frames, still empty, already dusted.

Vesper dusts them every morning. "They're for strips we haven't made yet. No rush. They'll keep."

items.label: A big red armchair

card.title: The Reading Chair
card.text:
There's a blanket, a tea that's still warm, and a dent in the cushion exactly the shape of a gremlin.

A little card on the armrest: "Reserved for whoever needs a sit."

items.label: The long drawers under the frames

card.title: The Drawer of Forms
card.text:
Most drawers here hold sketches. One is labelled DISCLOSURE OF FEELINGS (FORM 7B).

It's full of forms. Every single one just says "I'm fine!" with a little doodle of a heart that's been scribbled out and then drawn back in.

items.label: A desk globe

card.title: The Nap Globe
card.text:
Little pins mark every place a gremlin has had a really good nap.

There are a lot of pins. Most of them are in this building.

items.label: An open book on the rug

card.title: A Library Card
card.text:
Tucked in the book: a library card from the Lost Gremlin Library.

Due date: "whenever you're done." Nobody knows where that library is. The card seems to think it's close.

items.label: The Gremlin Guestbook. Tap to read it or sign it.
A little crawlspace hatch, up to the Lantern Loft

greet.text: You climbed all those stairs? Come sit. The tomatoes are nearly ready and the tea already is.

items.label: The stair hut, back down to the Archive
A little tea table for two

card.title: Tea for Two
card.text:
Two cups, one pot, two cushions that face the sunset.

The gremlins have a rule up here: you can't talk about work until the first cup is empty. Most days they forget to talk about work at all.

items.label: A hammock between the planters

card.title: The Hammock
card.text:
A sign tied to the hammock: "For lying in. That's it. That's the instructions."

It sways a little, even with no wind.

items.label: A green watering can

card.title: The Spare Watering Can
card.text:
Pip keeps a watering can down in the office too, but that one is for one very particular plant.

This one is for everything else. It's shared. It's patient. It does a little every day.

items.label: A basket of fresh eggs

card.title: From the Chickens
card.text:
A note on the basket: "Back after tai chi. Please don't wait up. Cluck."

Nobody has ever seen the chickens' tai chi. Everyone agrees it's probably very good.

items.label: A birdhouse on the wall

card.title: Vacancy
card.text:
The birdhouse has a tiny sign: NO VACANCY.

Inside you can hear a small, happy snore.

items.label: The moon, coming up early

card.title: Early Moon
card.text: The moon came up a bit early tonight. It likes this garden too.

items.label: A round skylight, down to Moth's Lantern Loft
A hole in the planks with glowing mushrooms: the Root Tunnel

greet.text: Welcome to the arcade! Three cabinets work now: OFFICE OLYMPICS and GARDEN GREMLINS are the calm ones. The purple one, BREAK ROOM BRAWL, is for friendly rivals: short rounds and real top-10 boards. Also, somebody lost a sock in here. Not me. Probably.

items.label: Bead curtain, back to the Tunnel
The claw machine

card.title: The Gentle Claw
card.text:
You press the button. The claw floats down, picks up a little plush mushroom, gives it a squeeze, and puts it back exactly where it was.

That's the whole game. Everyone in there gets a hug eventually.

items.label: Office Olympics arcade cabinet. Tap to play.
Garden Gremlins arcade cabinet. Tap to play.
Break Room Brawl arcade cabinet, the competitive one. Tap to play.
The chalk scoreboard for Break Room Brawl
items.title: BRAWL BOARD

items.label: A cabinet with swirly art

card.title: Swirl Mode
card.text:
The screen is just colours, gently swirling. There are no buttons that do anything.

The gremlins call it the most relaxing game in the building. Nobody has ever lost.

items.label: A skee-ball lane

card.title: Skee-Ball
card.text:
Every ball you roll scores the same: NICE.

The tickets that come out are blank. Noodle uses them as bookmarks.

items.label: An old TV and a console

card.title: Two-Player Co-op
card.text:
There's only one game on this console: two gremlins carry a very large sandwich across a bridge, together.

You can't lose. You can only drop the sandwich and laugh.

items.label: A big yellow bean bag

card.title: Pause Button
card.text:
The bean bag has a controller left on it, paused.

A sticky note on the controller: "Paused. Went for a stretch. Back soon."

items.label: A disco ball on the ceiling

card.title: Very Slow Disco
card.text: The disco ball turns about once an hour. The gremlins find this ideal.

items.label: A stray sock
items.say: That's MY sock! I must have danced right out of it. Thank you, dear.

greet.text: Welcome to the Wing. Six doors, six gremlins. Knock gently, everyone's in, and every room has a way back here.

items.label: The GREMLINS ONLY door, back to the Office
Grimble's round oak door: The Listening Burrow
Pip's glass door: The Idea Greenhouse
Moth's lavender door: The Lantern Loft
Dot's ink-striped door: The Back-Room Press
Noodle's porthole door: The Dispatch Loft
Vesper's door with a book slot: The Returns Bin
A see-through iPad on a stand

card.title: Hello from the iPad
card.text:
Bryan pops up as a small, friendly hologram on the see-through iPad, waves, and flickers off again.

This is the only way he visits the Wing. The rooms past these doors belong to the gremlins.

items.label: A notice by the door

card.title: House Notice
card.text:
Gremlin Wing. Knock gently.
Every room has a way back here.

Underneath, smaller, in six handwritings: "agreed", "agreed", "agreed (with tea)", "ok", "!!", "noted -V".

items.label: A long rug: wipe your paws

card.title: Wipe Your Paws
card.text: The rug has been wiped on so politely that it's now the cleanest thing in the building.

greet.text: Come in, sit anywhere. Nobody's in trouble. I mostly just listen down here.

items.label: Round door to the Cool-Off Corridor
Two mismatched armchairs and two teacups

card.title: Sit. Talk.
card.text:
Two armchairs that don't match, a tiny table, two teacups already poured.

Grimble's rule down here: listening first, fixing second. Most things feel smaller once someone's actually heard them.

items.label: Round window up to the meadow

card.title: The Meadow Window
card.text: A round window at grass level. Mostly you see stems, a bit of sky, and the occasional very surprised beetle.

items.label: The COMPLAINTS cabinet

card.title: Complaints
card.text: One drawer. One tiny folder. Inside, a single note: "The kettle is too loud." Someone has written underneath: "Fixed. Got a quieter kettle. -G"

items.label: The NICE THINGS PEOPLE SAID cabinet (it won't close)

card.title: Nice Things People Said
card.text:
This cabinet is so full it won't close. Grimble has stopped trying.

A few slips on top: "Thanks for listening." "You remembered my tea." "I feel lighter." "The comic made my week."

items.label: A sock, folded neatly in the inbox tray

card.title: Filed Under: Sock
card.text: Grimble's sock, folded into a perfect square and placed in the inbox tray. It is not lost. It is pending.

items.label: A clock, a few minutes slow

card.title: Slow on Purpose
card.text:
It's {localtime}, roughly. The burrow clock says a few minutes earlier, on purpose.

"Gives everyone a little extra time to arrive," says Grimble.

items.label: An oval plaque over the door, in Gremlish

card.title: Over the Door, in Gremlish
card.text:
Two short lines of glyphs, carved and polished. Grimble reads them every time he goes in or out.

If you crack it, keep it to yourself for a bit.

items.label: An ear trumpet: Listening Equipment

card.title: Listening Equipment
card.text:
A brass ear trumpet with a little tag: LISTENING EQUIPMENT.

Grimble doesn't actually use it. He says it reminds him what the job is.

items.label: A small hanging sign

card.title: Hold My Calls
card.text: The sign is hanging upside down. Grimble says that means "unless it's a nice call."

items.label: A desk nameplate

card.title: Head Gremlin, Probably
card.text: Nobody remembers voting. Grimble didn't ask. It just sort of happened, and it's been working out.

items.label: A very thick folder: PIP & PLANT

card.title: File: Pip & Plant
card.text:
The thickest folder in the burrow. Inside, one blank sheet.

"Nothing to report," says Grimble. "They're very happy."

items.label: A little sign: GREMLIN WING, this way

greet.text: Mind the seedlings! Every jar's an idea. Some are ready, some are resting. All of them count.

items.label: Glowing-mushroom root tunnel under the potting bench
A little brick burrow: The Someday Shelf
Shelves of idea jars

card.title: The Idea Jars
card.text: Floor to ceiling, every jar holds one idea. Some glow. Some are napping. Pip labels them all, even the silly ones. Especially the silly ones.

lines: *pop* "A hat for the plant" floats out as a bubble.
*pop* "Soup, but fancy" drifts up to the roof.

items.label: The Plant, on its tiny armchair

card.title: The Plant Blushes
card.text:
Third splash and the plant goes properly pink. A flower pops out, right on top.

Pip pretends not to notice. Pip noticed.

lines: *sploosh* The plant sits up a little straighter.
*sploosh* The plant goes a faint shade of pink.

items.label: A heart-shaped watering can

card.title: The Heart-Shaped Can
card.text: It only waters one plant. It has never once been used on anything else.

items.label: A lightbulb, sprouting leaves

card.title: Idea in Progress
card.text: A lightbulb that's grown two leaves and a root. It doesn't switch on yet. Pip waters it anyway.

items.label: A sign over the potting bench

card.title: Over the Bench
card.text: Not everything has to bloom today. Water it anyway.

items.text:
Not everything has to bloom today.
Water it anyway.

items.label: The compost bin

card.title: Ideas Resting (Not Dead)
card.text:
Ideas that didn't work out go here to rest. They turn into soil, and the soil grows the next ones.

Nothing in here is wasted. It's just early.

items.label: A rain gauge: Brainstorm Level

card.title: Brainstorm Level
card.text: The gauge always reads SOME. It has never read NONE. Pip checks it every morning, just to be sure.

items.label: A sock, planted in a pot

card.title: What Grows from a Sock?
card.text: Pip planted a sock to see what would happen. So far: nothing. Pip is very patient.

items.label: A butterfly net: Idea Net

doneSay.text: Look at all those jars! Half-finished ones count too, you know.

items.label: A little sign: GREMLIN WING, this way

greet.text: Glow-mushrooms light the way. Root steps go up to the roof; the sunny arch behind you is the greenhouse.

items.label: Sunny archway, back to the Idea Greenhouse
Root steps, up to the Rooftop Garden
Glowing caps across the root ceiling

card.title: Everything's Connected
card.text: These roots belong to the rooftop garden. The greenhouse feeds them, they hold up the roof. Nobody's in charge. It works.

items.label: Friendly glowing mushrooms by the steps

card.title: Friendly Mushrooms
card.text: They glow a little brighter when someone walks past. Pip says they're just being polite.

items.label: A little hollow full of acorns

card.title: Somebody's Pantry
card.text: A neat little stash of acorns. Pip doesn't know whose they are, so Pip leaves one extra every week, just in case.

items.label: A root shelf with three seedling pots

card.title: The Nursery Shelf
card.text: Three seedlings, getting used to the dark before they go up to the roof. Pip visits them every morning to say good luck.

items.label: Orange mushrooms climbing a root

card.title: Mushroom Stairs
card.text: They grew in a neat little column all by themselves. Pip is fairly sure they want to see the roof too.

greet.text: This is where ideas wait. Not forgotten, just saved for later. They like it here.

items.label: Sunny root arch and steps, back to the Idea Greenhouse
The Someday Shelf: jars of saved ideas

card.title: Saved for Later
card.text:
Every jar here is an idea that isn't ready yet: a ukulele for the plant, a hat for every sock, a rocking bench, a slower Monday.

They're not failures. They're just waiting for the right weather.

items.label: A jar with a cloth cap on

card.title: Do Not Disturb
card.text: This idea is napping. Pip put a little cloth cap on it so the light doesn't wake it. It'll get up when it's ready.

items.label: A calendar with nothing on it but one sprout

card.title: This Month
card.text: Nothing scheduled. Just one little sprout doodled in a square, any day it likes. Pip says that's a full calendar.

items.label: A seedling under a glass cloche

card.title: Taking Its Time
card.text: Some ideas need a little glass house of their own while they get going. This one is doing great. It just doesn't want to be watched too closely.

items.label: A squashy thinking cushion

card.title: A Cushion for Waiting
card.text: For sitting beside an idea that isn't ready. You don't have to do anything. Just keep it company.

items.label: The special jar: one bud, glowing

card.title: Not Yet
card.text: One bud, glowing softly, not open yet. Pip checks on it every day and says the same thing every time: "not yet, and that's fine."

items.label: Drawers of seed packets

card.title: Seed Packets
card.text: Every packet is labelled in Pip's handwriting. None of them say when to plant. Pip says the seeds will let you know.

greet.text: Shh, the ink's drying. Make yourself small and cozy. The lanterns don't mind company.

items.label: Sketchbook-lined crawlspace, to the Archive
Round skylight and rope ladder, up to the Rooftop Garden
The moon desk lamp

opts.title: One Lantern, Breathing
opts.intro: The room dims to one lantern. Follow its glow for three slow breaths.
opts.note: Breathe at your own pace. Skip the hold if it's uncomfortable.
opts.end: You don't have to fill every panel.

doneSay.text: Lanterns back on. Take your time.

items.label: A drafting table with a half-finished panel

card.title: Half a Panel
card.text:
The panel's half inked: a gremlin, a teacup, and a lot of empty space.

Moth leaves it that way on purpose some days. The empty bit is where the quiet goes.

items.label: A tan cardigan on the chair

card.title: Pencils in Every Pocket
card.text: Every pocket has a pencil in it. One pocket has three. One pencil is just a twig Moth liked the look of.

items.label: A jar of folded slips: Collected Captions

card.title: Collected Captions
card.text:
Moth's favourite captions, folded small:

"Tea, but make it weather."
"It has places to be."
"Dressed for the job it wants."
"Night shift says hi."
"The frog has accepted this."

items.label: Drying comic page 1: Caption This
Drying comic page 2: Caption This
Drying comic page 3: Caption This
Drying comic page 4: Caption This
Drying comic page 5: Caption This
Every lantern, lit

card.title: Every Lantern Lit
card.text:
You found all five moths, and every lantern in the loft has woken up to say thank you.

Moth is pretending to be very busy inking. Moth is smiling.

items.label: A tiny moth doodle
A tiny moth doodle
A tiny moth doodle
A tiny moth doodle
A tiny moth doodle
A little ladder hatch marked ILLUSTRATIONS, down to the Stacks Below
A little sign: GREMLIN WING, this way

greet.text: Mind the wet ink! Everything in here is a first draft. That's the best kind.

items.label: Paper-lined tunnel behind the ream stack: The Proof Room
A hand-crank letterpress

card.title: It Prints by Itself
card.text:
Nobody's cranking it. Every so often it prints a word anyway: seed, breathe, later.

Dot says it knows what people need to read.

items.label: A low radio

card.title: The Press Jingle
card.text:
♪ Ink it, print it, pin it up,
wonky's fine and so's a smudge,
first drafts welcome, come on in,
every print's a place to begin ♪

(Dot hums it all day. Nobody minds.)

lines: A little crackle, then a hum.

items.label: A wall of framed misprints

card.title: The Misprint Gallery
card.text:
Every frame holds a print that went a bit wrong: a sun that slid, a balloon that doubled, a star that went pink.

Dot framed them all. They're her favourites.

items.label: The light table: Line It Up

doneSay.text: Pin it up! Every print goes on the wall.

items.label: A tall stack of paper reams

card.title: Pushed Aside
card.text: Somebody shoved the reams over to get at the tunnel. Paper dust everywhere. Dot calls it ambience.

items.label: A squeegee hung like a sword

card.title: The Squeegee of Destiny
card.text: Hung over the screen frame like a sword. Dot only takes it down for the important prints.

items.label: Flyers for events that haven't happened yet

card.title: Coming Soon (Ish)
card.text:
Flyers for things that might happen one day: a sock swap, a quiet hour, kite day, a plant show, nap club.

None have dates. That's part of the fun.

items.label: A glowing jar of scraps

card.title: Bleed & Trim
card.text: All the edges cut off the prints. Dot can't throw them out. They glow a little, like they're proud of being part of something.

items.label: A sleepy cat on the cardstock

card.title: The Paper-Cutter Cat
card.text: Not a paper cutter. A cat who sleeps on the paper cutter's cardstock. She supervises. Mostly with her eyes closed.

items.label: A little registration target

card.title: In Register
card.text:
You found all four crop marks. Dot is thrilled: the whole room is officially in register.

(It's still a bit wonky. That's fine.)

items.label: A tiny crop mark
A tiny crop mark
A tiny crop mark
A tiny crop mark
A brass tube hatch, up to the Dispatch Loft
A little book-lined hatch, down to the Stacks Below
A little sign: GREMLIN WING, this way

greet.text: The Proof Room! Proofs get read slowly in here, on a comfy seat, with kind little notes in the margins.

items.label: Glowing paper tunnel, back to the Back-Room Press
Proof sheets pegged on a line

card.title: Kind Proof Marks
card.text:
The margin notes in here are all kind: "nice!", "tiny bit left?", "yes :)".

In the Proof Room, a correction is just a friend pointing.

items.label: A round window seat with cushions

card.title: Read Slowly
card.text: A seat for reading slowly. Slowly is how you catch the little things, and how you notice the good bits too.

items.label: A teacup and a loupe

card.title: Checking the Dots
card.text: A loupe for looking at the tiny dots that make up a print. Up close, every picture is just lots of small dots trying their best together.

items.label: A framed seedling print

card.title: A Collab
card.text: Pip drew the seedling, Dot printed it. It came out a tiny bit out of register and they both liked it better that way.

items.label: An open book on the braided rug

card.title: Left Open on Purpose
card.text: Dot leaves a book open on the rug so whoever comes in next can pick up where it stops. Today it stops on a nice bit.

greet.text: Welcome to Dispatch! Everything gets where it's going. Eventually. Mostly. Snacks first.

items.label: A wall of pneumatic tubes

card.title: The Tube Wall
card.text:
Capsules whoosh about all day: memos, sketches, a sock (twice), and once, a very confused biscuit.

They all arrive. Just not always in order.

items.label: The departures board

card.title: Departures
card.text: Everything's departing on time-ish. Noodle updates the board whenever he remembers, which is often, because he likes the clacky noise it makes in his head.

items.text:
THE KETTLE    BOARDING
SOMEDAY       ON TIME-ISH
MONDAY        DELAYED (FINE)
THE ROOF      NAPPING
LOST SOCKS    ARRIVING

items.label: A hand-drawn wonky schedule

card.title: The Schedule
card.text: Colour blocks, no words. Noodle can read it perfectly. Nobody else can. It has never once been wrong. It has also never once been on time.

items.label: A bowl of noodles that's never cold

card.title: The Never-Cold Bowl
card.text: Always warm, always steaming. Nobody knows how. Noodle says it's "just good noodles".

items.label: A racing-stripe chair: NOODLE 1

card.title: Noodle 1
card.text: Three spins and the chair does a little victory wobble. Noodle claims the record is eleven spins. Nobody has seen it.

items.label: A tray of capsules

lines: A capsule note: "Found the C plate. It was in my apron. -Dot"
A capsule note: "Please return the moon lamp's moth. -Moth"
A capsule note: "Book overdue. No rush. Love, the library"

items.label: A red-string corkboard

card.title: Who's Bringing Snacks?
card.text:
Red string, pins, sticky notes. It looks like a big mystery. It's just the snack rota.

The string always ends up pointing at Noodle.

items.label: A round window with a night train

card.title: The 2 AM Train
card.text: A tiny night train crosses the window, always at two in the morning, always with one light on. Noodle waves at it. It never waves back. He keeps waving.

items.label: A note card pinned to the wall

card.title: One Thing at a Time
card.text:
One thing at a time. The rest will wait.

Noodle wrote it on a busy day and pinned it where he'd see it.

items.text:
One thing
at a time.
The rest
will wait.

items.label: Six inbox trays: Sort the Chaos

doneSay.text: Sorted! Ish! That's my favourite amount of sorted.

items.label: Tube crawlspace behind the corkboard, down to Dot's Press
Little hatch with a sock poking out
A little sign: GREMLIN WING, this way

greet.text: Every sock that ever went missing ends up here eventually. They all have tags. They all have stories.

items.label: Brass porthole, back up to the Dispatch Loft
Cubbies full of single socks

card.title: Last Seen
card.text:
Each sock has a tag saying where it was last seen: in a teapot, sunbathing on the roof, inside another sock, on the moon (maybe).

The five socks you're hunting aren't here. They're still out in the rooms, having adventures.

items.label: The sock with the darned patch

card.title: Still Waiting
card.text: This one's been mended with care, and it's still waiting for its pair. It's in no hurry. It knows they'll turn up.

items.label: The tube catch-tray

card.title: Just Arrived
card.text: Fwump. A sock, fresh from Dispatch. It has a tag: "FOUND BEHIND THE SNACK DRAWER. SORRY. -N"

items.label: A clothesline of mismatched socks

card.title: Drying Line
card.text: Freshly found socks, drying before they go home. None of them match. They seem to get on very well anyway.

items.label: Two socks that are almost a pair

card.title: Almost a Pair
card.text: Not quite the same, but close. Noodle has decided that counts.

items.text:
LOST SOMETHING?
It's probably
just resting.
- the socks

items.label: A note pinned to the cork

card.title: The Lost & Found Book
card.text:
Every entry in the same handwriting:
"One sock. Stripy. Found."
"One sock. Spotty. Found."
"One mood. Grumpy. Found (it was hungry)."

items.label: Stray socks on the floor

card.title: Escapees
card.text: Two socks that made a run for it. They didn't get far. They seem pleased with themselves.

greet.text: Oh, hello. Mind the frogs, they're everywhere. Sit, read, scribble in the margins. The margins are the good part.

items.label: A rainy window

card.title: Sit with It a Minute
card.text:
Sit with it a minute.

The rain doesn't need anything from you. It's just keeping you company.

items.label: An oversized reading chair

card.title: The Big Chair
card.text: Sticky notes all over it, each one a page number someone wanted to come back to. Nobody minds how long it takes.

items.label: The book-return slot: Shelve It

doneSay.text: Thank you. The rest can wait in the pile. It likes it there.

items.label: A dented returns bin with a blanket nest

card.title: The Nap Nook
card.text: A dented returns bin, lined with every blanket that was ever left in a library. Vesper's favourite reading spot, and a gold-star nap nook.

items.label: A giant used textbook on a lectern

card.title: Margin Notes
card.text:
The margins are full of notes from everyone who read it before you:

"You don't have to finish the chapter today."
"Rereading counts."
"Confusion is the first page of learning something."
"??" (a classic)

items.label: Gap behind the poetry shelf, down to the Stacks Below
Two coats on the hook

card.title: Two Coats
card.text: Two coats, hung neatly. They turn up on editorial days. Vesper keeps the hook clear for them.

items.label: Books bristling with sticky notes

card.title: So Many Sticky Notes
card.text: Every book on this shelf has been loved hard. Each sticky note is someone saying "this bit, this bit right here".

items.label: A card catalog

card.title: The Card Catalog
card.text: Every drawer is labelled in Vesper's tiny handwriting, and none of them contain what the label says. That's half the fun. Try a few.

items.label: A card-catalog drawer, pulled open

card.title: Filed Under: T
card.text: A teacup, still warm. Nobody knows who filed it.

items.label: A card-catalog drawer, pulled open

card.title: Filed Under: M
card.text: A moth, reading. It looks up, nods politely, and goes back to its page.

items.label: A card-catalog drawer, pulled open

card.title: Filed Under: S
card.text: A single stripy sock. Not one of the five you're hunting, Vesper says. This one's just visiting the library.

items.label: A card-catalog drawer, pulled open

card.title: Filed Under: G
card.text: A globe that spins by itself, slowly, like it's thinking.

items.label: A typewriter that types by itself

card.title: It Types by Itself
card.text: Clack... clack... clack. It types the same line over and over, very slowly, as if it wants to get it right: "Margins are where understanding happens."

items.label: The frog family, all together

card.title: The Frog Family
card.text:
You found all seven margin frogs. They've gathered on the big chair for a quiet little croak of thanks.

Vesper asked for them to stay. They're staying.

items.label: A tiny frog doodle
A tiny frog doodle
A tiny frog doodle
A tiny frog doodle
A tiny frog doodle
A tiny frog doodle
A tiny frog doodle
A little sign: GREMLIN WING, this way

greet.text: The Stacks Below. The lamps float, the books lean, and every path leads back up the stairs.

items.label: Lamp-lit stair, up to the Returns Bin
Book archway, on to Dot's Print Shop
A little hatch marked ILLUSTRATIONS, up the ladder to Moth's Lantern Loft
A clear cream wall of kind margin notes

card.title: Kind Margin Notes
card.text:
Vesper keeps this wall for notes that were too nice to leave in just one book.

Vesper adds the best ones she finds. The only rule is the one over Grimble's door: say it kindly.

items.text: You don't have to finish today.

items.label: Floating paper lanterns

card.title: Floating Lamps
card.text: Nobody hung them. They just float, keeping the stacks lit. If you stand still, one drifts over to read with you.

items.label: A teacup on a stack of books

card.title: Still Warm
card.text: A teacup on a stack of books. It's always warm. Nobody has ever seen who refills it.

items.label: A low stool with a plum cushion

card.title: Just One More Chapter
card.text: The perfect height for sitting down to check one thing and staying for a whole chapter.

greet.text: Take the long way down the corridor. In... and out. There's a bench at the end. Come back when your shoulders drop.

items.label: Round oak door, back to the Listening Burrow
The plaque over the door, in Gremlish

card.title: Over the Door, in Gremlish
card.text: Three words in Gremlish, carved a bit wobbly. Grimble did it himself. It's the same plaque as the one in the Burrow, so you see it on the way in and on the way out.

items.label: The bench at the end: breathe a little
items.hover: Come back when your shoulders drop.

opts.title: The Long Way Round
opts.intro: Sit for a moment. Follow the circle: in for four, out for six. Breathe at your own pace.
opts.note: Breathe at your own pace. Stop whenever you like.
opts.end: That's the whole corridor. Come back whenever you need it.

doneSay.text: Shoulders down. Nicely done. No rush getting up.

items.label: A little plate over the bench, in Gremlish

card.title: Over the Bench, in Gremlish
card.text: Two words, painted carefully. You can feel what they mean even before you read them.

items.label: The round window at the end of the corridor

card.title: Nothing Much Out There
card.text: A sunny meadow, and one cloud taking its time. It doesn't look like it's in a hurry, so you don't have to be either.

items.label: Painted footprints up the runner: in... out...

card.title: In... Out...
card.text:
Footprints painted down the runner: sage for in, cream for out. In... out... in... out...

Grimble painted them on a day he needed them. He left them for whoever needs them next.

items.label: A framed pressed leaf

card.title: One Good Leaf
card.text: Grimble found it on a walk and liked it so much he framed it. That's the whole story. Not every story needs a twist.

items.label: A soft green scarf on a peg

card.title: The Borrowing Scarf
card.text: A soft green scarf for anyone who gets chilly on the bench. A tag on it says: BORROW ME. BRING ME BACK WHENEVER.

prize.title: All five socks are home!
prize.text: Every gremlin has a warm foot again. They made you a tiny trophy out of the socks (they've since asked for them back).
prize.note: They're very pleased with themselves. Thanks for looking.

arcade._readme: Playable cabinets. Each machine: title, tagline, colours, the script that registers its games (games/<id>.js), and a menu of games. A game listed here without code shows as COMING SOON. Each game: id (matches GremlinArcade.register), name, blurb, scoreLabel, best ('high' or 'low' = fewer is better), pad (on-screen buttons), actionLabel, keysHelp, touchHelp, prize (OFF; see README-world.md before touching).

office-olympics.title: OFFICE OLYMPICS
office-olympics.tagline: Desk sports for very small athletes
office-olympics.hint: Three desk sports. Nobody gets fired.

games.name: Desk Tennis
games.blurb: Bat a donut past a lazy stapler. It stops for coffee.
games.keysHelp: ↑ ↓ or W / S to move. The mouse works too. First to 5.
games.touchHelp: Drag in the strip behind your gremlin (or use ▲ ▼). First to 5.

games.name: Paper Plane Toss
games.blurb: Flick planes into the recycling. The desk fan has opinions.
games.keysHelp: ↑ ↓ aim, ← → power, Space throws. Or drag back and let go.
games.touchHelp: Drag back like a slingshot and let go. Six planes a round.

games.name: Stapler Stack
games.blurb: Stack desk things into a tower. It will wobble.

garden-gremlins.title: GARDEN GREMLINS
garden-gremlins.hint: Plants, socks and seeds. Nothing here can wilt for long.

games.name: Hungry Vine
games.blurb: Pip's plant grows toward water drops and sunbeams.
games.keysHelp: Arrow keys or WASD to steer. Bonk something and it naps.
games.touchHelp: Swipe, tap beside the vine, or use the pad.

games.name: Sock Pairing
games.blurb: The laundry is out. Find each sock its soulmate.
games.keysHelp: Click a sock, or arrows + Space. Fewer tries is fancier.
games.touchHelp: Tap two cards to find a matching pair.

games.name: Seed Packet Bonk
games.blurb: Bounce a seed off a watering can to open every packet.
games.keysHelp: ← → or A / D (or the mouse) to move. Space plants the seed.
games.touchHelp: Drag along the strip below the can to move, tap to plant.

break-room-brawl.title: BREAK ROOM BRAWL
break-room-brawl.tagline: Quick games. Friendly rivals. Top 10 boards.
break-room-brawl.hint: The competitive cabinet: short rounds and shared top-10 boards. Still very polite.

games.name: Coffee Relay
games.blurb: Carry wobbly mugs to thirsty desks. One minute. Don't spill!
games.keysHelp: Arrows or WASD to walk. Smooth moves keep the mug steady. 60 seconds.
games.touchHelp: Drag on the screen to walk (or use the pad). 60 seconds.

games.name: Jam Buster
games.blurb: The printers keep jamming. Bop the jams, build combos. 45 seconds.
games.keysHelp: Click a jam, or arrows + Space. Bopping an empty printer breaks your combo.
games.touchHelp: Tap the jams as they pop up. Gold ones are worth more.

games.name: Desk Duel (2P)
games.blurb: Two players, one desk, one very fast donut. First to 7.
games.keysHelp: Left player W / S, right player ↑ / ↓. First to 7. Just for fun, no board.
games.touchHelp: Each player drags in the strip behind their own paddle. First to 7.

badges._readme: Fun stamps for the quest journal. Rule types: rooms (n), allRooms, sockHunt, sockTime (ms), secrets (n), allSecrets, playedAll, event (awarded by code: brawl-score, brawl-top10), hours (from..to, local clock). Ids must also be in gw.known_ids (kind 'badge'). No prizes, no codes.

list.name: Speedy Socks
list.desc: Finished the sock hunt in under 3 minutes.

list.name: Arcade Tourist
list.desc: Played every arcade game at least once.

list.name: On The Board
list.desc: Put a first score on a Break Room Brawl board.

list.name: Top Ten Gremlin
list.desc: Finished in a Break Room Brawl top 10.

list.name: Night Owl
list.desc: Visited after midnight. Shh, the gremlins are napping.

guestbook._readme: Preset lines only (no free text). Ids must match gw.guestbook_phrases / gw.guestbook_stamps; the server's text is what gets shown.

phrases.text: The socks are watching. Kindly.
I came for the art, stayed for the stapler.
Ten out of ten. Would get lost in the tunnel again.
I petted the ficus. It approved.
Left a crumb for Grimble. You're welcome.
The chair in the Archive is very good at its job.
I found a sock and gave it back. Hero stuff.
The kettle and I are friends now.
Please tell Moth the paintings are lovely.
I lost at Desk Tennis to a stapler. Worth it.
Visited the rooftop. The moon waved.
My houseplant says hello.
Brought snacks. Ate snacks. Sorry.
The disco ball is my spirit animal.
Please file me under 'snacks'.
Noodle, I believe in you.
This guestbook smells faintly of tea.
Came in quietly. Leaving quietly. Very cozy.
Officially a part-time gremlin now.
Hello from a very small desk far away.

moths.line: A moth doodle! That's {n} of {total}. One lantern wakes up.
moths.doneSay: All five moths! Look at the lanterns.

crops.line: A crop mark! {n} of {total}. The room's lining up.
crops.doneSay: All four crop marks. We're in register! Check the back wall.

frogs.line: A margin frog. {n} of {total}. It croaks very quietly.
frogs.again: That frog's already said hello. {n} of {total}.
frogs.doneSay: All seven frogs! They're gathering on the big chair.

_readme_wing: Gremlin Wing (Oct 25): hallway 'wing' off the Office's GREMLINS ONLY door (officeSkip hides the old locked-door card), six painted personal rooms (burrow, greenhouse, lantern, press, dispatch, returns) and six painted side rooms by Moth (corridor, roots, someday, proof, lostfound, stacks); only the wing hallway is drawn (tools/draw-wing.py). Item types added: decor (non-interactive overlay text/img; cycle, typewriter, cls), game (games/room-games.js: sort, lineup, shelve, caption, net, breathe), setpiece (sets: tap all to reveal showIf items). Egg extras: steps (gentle taps before the card), hover, showIf ('<egg id>' or 'set:<name>').
